subject: Agriculture
title: Loss of Crop Diversity
description: A quick win: understand Loss of Crop Diversity.

hook.text: India once grew 30,000 rice varieties. Today, a handful dominate. The rest are nearly extinct.

buildup.text: Green Revolution varieties replaced thousands of local landraces that had adapted over centuries.

discovery.text: Each lost variety carried unique genes—drought tolerance, pest resistance, flavor—evolved over millennia.

twist.text: If a new disease strikes modern varieties, the genes to fight it may already be extinct.

climax.text: Seed banks like Svalbard store samples, but frozen seeds can't evolve. Living diversity is irreplaceable.

punchline.text: We chose the most productive seeds and lost the rest. Efficiency ate diversity.

quiz.question: How many rice varieties did India historically grow before the Green Revolution?
